# stalwart_oauth_client (Resource)

Defines a registered OAuth client application.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String) Unique identifier of the OAuth client

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `contacts` (Set of String) Contact email addresses for the OAuth client
- `description` (String) Description of the OAuth client
- `expires_at` (String) Expiration date of the OAuth client
- `logo` (String) URL or base64-encoded image representing the OAuth client
- `member_tenant_id` (String) Identifier for the tenant this OAuth client belongs to
- `redirect_uris` (Set of String) List of redirect URIs for the OAuth client
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret value of the OAuth client
- `secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only variant of `secret`. The value is sent to the server but never stored in state. Set `secret_wo_version` and change it to roll the secret. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later.
- `secret_wo_version` (Number) Version counter for `secret_wo`. Change this value to send the current `secret_wo` value to the server again.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation date of the OAuth client
- `id` (String) Server-assigned identifier.
